evidence: Noteworthy, in order to produce a metallic Ru film after 150 ALD cycles, the reduced deposition temperature of 250 ◦C required an increased ECPRu exposure time of 10 s twice, intermitted by a 15 s Ar purge, compared to 12.5 s once at 330 ◦C. The O 2 dose was fixed to a 10 s exposure time of 200 sccm (almost undiluted) O 2 flow. An Ar gas flow of 2,000 sccm purged the two gas channels in the shower head, as well as the reaction chamber for 30 s after each respective ALD half-reaction.
